International Flavors Meet Midwest Charm

La Mie Express

This beloved bakery-café brings a taste of Paris to Des Moines with freshly baked croissants, artisanal sandwiches, and locally roasted coffee. Perfect for morning meetings or weekend brunches, La Mie Express captures the essence of Drake neighborhood's European-inspired architecture.

Gazali's Mediterranean Grill

A neighborhood institution for over 15 years, Gazali's serves authentic Mediterranean cuisine that draws visitors from across the metro area. Their falafel and shawarma have achieved near-legendary status among Drake students and Des Moines foodies alike.
